name: cfd-talent-intel-core
description: Shared ATS-backed talent intelligence backend for VT Markets HR. Scrapes Workable / Greenhouse / Workday / Lever / SmartRecruiters / Ashby / Recruitis directly, aggregates by region, and serves JSON via a Cloudflare Worker that the EU+UK / LATAM / MENA / APAC / Prop-firm dashboards consume.
